channel.title: zyekh.com — Technical Articles & Security Insights
channel.description: Technical articles, Linux kernel news, system hardening guides, and cybersecurity research by Zyekh Abdul Qadir Jailani.

item.title: Comprehensive Linux VPS Hardening Blueprint for 2026
item.description: Production-grade security blueprint for Debian and Ubuntu Linux servers. Includes SSH key enforcement, kernel sysctl parameters, UFW rate-limiting, Fail2Ban auditing, and automated updates.

item.title: Why Minimalist Static Hosting Outperforms Monolithic Frameworks for Security
item.description: Architectural analysis comparing static edge hosting to monolithic server frameworks. Examines attack surface reduction, TTFB performance benchmarks, zero server maintenance, and pure CSS design systems.

item.title: Nginx Reverse Proxy Security Hardening Blueprint for 2026
item.description: Production guide for hardening Nginx reverse proxies with TLS 1.3, rate limiting, buffer overflow defense, and security headers.

item.title: Implementing Strict Content Security Policy (CSP) & Security Headers
item.description: Comprehensive technical guide for configuring strict Content Security Policy (CSP), HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS), X-Content-Type-Options, and Nginx security headers.

item.title: Understanding eBPF for Real-Time Linux Security Monitoring
item.description: Technical deep-dive on Extended Berkeley Packet Filter (eBPF) tracing, kprobes, tracepoints, bpftrace, and zero-overhead kernel runtime security monitoring.

item.title: Zero-Trust SSH Access Blueprint: FIDO2 Hardware Keys & SSH Certificate Authority
item.description: Comprehensive technical blueprint for securing Linux SSH infrastructure using FIDO2/YubiKey hardware tokens, SSH Certificate Authority (SSH CA), and short-lived certificates.
